name: Lin Zhaoyu
source: The first and oldest of the 7 disciples. She started following and serving Fu Hua at age 6 and officially became her disciple at age 18. She is the leader of the 'school of Taixuan' one of the 6 great schools of martial arts. She is married to the 6th disciple, Ma Feima but has no children.
